answer_1.quote: For sentence level paraphrasing, we use Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer (T5) fine-tuned over positive samples from Quora Question Pairs (QQP) dataset for question paraphrasing.

answer_2.quote: The dataset is formulated as a classification task with exactly one correct answer, so we use standard accuracy as evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation with respect to 500 samples from the CLEVR_HYP dataset. Accuracy of human evaluations on original test, 2HopA T and 2HopQ H are 98.4%, 96.2% and 96.6% respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Accuracy of answers to hypothetical questions
